shadows.name: tile-lift

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action in heroes and tools; ink fill, presses in.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--f-ui); font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s var(--ease-out), background-color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: oklch(from var(--ink) calc(l + 0.08) c h); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: var(--f-ui); font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.9375rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .12s var(--ease-out), background-color .15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--paper-2); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Mode switch in tool bars; pressed option inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: var(--radius); overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--f-ui); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-seg button { font: inherit; font-weight: 600; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem; color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; min-height: 2.25rem; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Percentage Input
components.description: Vote-share entry in the simulator rows.
components.css: .ds-pct { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: 4.6rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--paper); } .ds-pct:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pct input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink); font: 600 1rem/1 var(--f-ui); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; padding: 0.45rem 0 0.45rem 0.45rem; text-align: right; outline: none; } .ds-pct span { padding: 0 0.4rem 0 0.15rem; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: var(--f-ui); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Masthead links; current page carries the sepia underline.
components.html: SimuladorMesa electoralVoto por correo
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.15rem; font-family: var(--f-ui); font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-nav a { text-decoration: none; padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem; color: var(--ink-2); border-radius: var(--radius); transition: color .15s, background-color .15s; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-2); } .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--sepia); border-radius: 0; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Answer Box
components.description: Direct answer under every guide and province page head.
components.html:
Respuesta rápida

La mesa electoral se sortea entre el 31 de octubre y el 4 de noviembre.

Recibirás la notificación en tu domicilio.
components.css: .ds-answer { position: relative; max-width: 50rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); padding: 1rem 1.5rem 1.5rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--f-read); } .ds-answer__label { position: absolute; top: -0.7rem; left: 1rem; background: var(--paper); padding: 0 0.4rem; font-family: var(--f-ui); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--sepia-ink); } .ds-answer p { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.05rem + 0.4vw, 1.3rem); line-height: 1.5; } .ds-answer p + p { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink-2); }

components.name: Plate with Cartogram Tiles
components.description: Numbered plate framing the tile cartogram, with legend and source foot.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--ink); background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-plate__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); font-family: var(--f-ui); } .ds-plate__title { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-plate__no { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-plate__body { padding: 1rem; } .ds-plate__foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); font-family: var(--f-ui); font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-carto { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 3.5rem); gap: 3px; } .ds-carto a { aspect-ratio: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0.18rem 0.25rem; text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--f-ui); line-height: 1; color: oklch(22% 0.03 258); border-radius: 2px; transition: transform .18s var(--ease-out), box-shadow .18s var(--ease-out); } .ds-carto a:hover, .ds-carto a:focus-visible { transform: scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -6px oklch(20% 0.03 258 / 0.45); position: relative; z-index: 2; } .ds-carto .c { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; opacity: .8; } .ds-carto .n { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 750; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; align-self: flex-end; }

components.name: Key-Fact Grid
components.description: Ruled definition grid of headline figures on home and province pages.
components.css: .ds-facts { margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); max-width: 28rem; } .ds-facts div { padding: 0.75rem 0.75rem 0.75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-facts div:nth-child(odd) { border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-facts div:nth-child(even) { padding-left: 0.75rem; } .ds-facts dt { font-family: var(--f-ui); font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-facts dd { margin: 0.15rem 0 0; font-family: var(--f-ui); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.15rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview:
The site is an electoral atlas printed by a statistics office. Every page is a plate: a hairline-framed box with a numbered head, a body of data, and a foot that carries the legend and the official source. Trust comes from precision and composition, not ornament. Paper white, blue-black ink, and one ochre accent taken from the real Senate ballot carry the whole identity; party colours appear only inside the data.

Density is that of a good statistical yearbook: tabular figures, thin rules, key facts in ruled grids, labels set small in Archivo. Reading prose switches to Source Serif 4 at a 40rem measure. Interaction is quiet and mechanical: a tile lifts, a seat dot re-colours, a segmented control inverts to ink.

The system rejects the newspaper election-special register: giant headline over candidate photos, front-page red, party colours used as page decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-framed plates (1px ink border) with head, body and source foot.
One accent, the Senate sepia, used as a mark (current item, list markers, dates, the highlighted word), never as a surface.
Archivo variable width: condensed (82–92% wdth) in headings, normal in UI and data.
Tabular numerals everywhere a number appears.
Sequential sepia ramp (six steps) for quantitative fills; party colours only in charts.
Flat paper; depth only on hover of interactive tiles.

rules.name: The One Ochre Rule
rules.body: The only non-data hue on the page is the Senate sepia family. Any other hue must come from a party or a data scale.

rules.name: The Party Colours Stay In The Data Rule
rules.body: Party colours appear only as chart fills, seat dots and legend swatches; never as backgrounds, borders, buttons or headings.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number (seats, percentages, dates, countdowns, votes) is set in Archivo with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Condensed Headings Rule
rules.body: Width narrows as size grows: 92% at title, 88% at headline, 82% at display. UI and data stay at normal width.

rules.name: The Ruled, Not Raised Rule
rules.body: Containers are separated by rules and paper tone. Shadows exist only as a response to pointer or focus on a data tile.

dos: **Do** put every chart, map and tool inside a plate with a numbered head and a source foot.
**Do** set every number in Archivo with tabular figures.
**Do** use Sepia Ink (sepia-ink) for accent text on paper and keep Senate Ballot Sepia (sepia) for lines, small fills and the dark folio strip.
**Do** separate blocks with rules: 1px hairline between rows, 1px ink around containers, 2px ink to open a group.
**Do** read every colour from tokens so dark mode carries through.
donts: **Don't** use party colours outside the data (backgrounds, buttons, borders, headings).
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue; the sepia family and the data scales are the full palette.
**Don't** raise containers with shadows; the tile lift on hover is the only shadow.
**Don't** round containers; plates, tools, answer boxes and sections stay square, controls stop at 3px.
**Don't** build the newspaper election special: giant headline over candidate photos or front-page red.
